svg.title: Northwood AWS demo topology
svg.desc: One VPC in one availability zone. The public subnet holds the NAT instance and the web EC2 (Caddy, the SPA's nginx, erp-web-ui-bff, Keycloak). The private app subnet holds the app EC2 with the seven services. The private data subnet holds the data EC2 with PostgreSQL, Kafka and the telemetry stack. ECR, S3, Secrets Manager, EventBridge Scheduler and Systems Manager are regional services outside the VPC; CloudFront and Route 53 are global.
svg.text: Internet · users, Let's Encrypt, image registries
S3 gateway endpoint: S3 and ECR image layers stay off the NAT
